description: HackNext'26 Series 2.0 is a 24-hour hackathon organized by SNS College of Technology at the AI Campus on 8–9 October 2026 . Team Size : 1–4 Members Registration Fee : ₹500 per head Problem Statement is provided on the spot Case Price : Upto ₹20000 Focus: Innovative Idea • Understandable Coding • Better Presentation Venue: AI Campus, SNS College of Technology Last Date to Register: 6 October 2026 Hackathon Date: 8–9 October 2026 Hackathon Duration: 24 Hours Reporting Time: 8:30 a.m. (08/10/2026) Website: https://hacknext26.vercel.app/ Registration Link Google Form: Click here to Register for HackNext 2.0 Guidelines Participants can register individually or form a team of 1–4 members . The problem statement will be announced on the spot . Participants may use any suitable programming language, framework, or technology. Teams must build their solution within the 24-hour hackathon period . Participants must bring their own laptop and required accessories. Teams should be prepared for a final project demo and presentation . Participants are responsible for their personal belongings and electronic devices. Organizers will not be responsible for any loss or damage. Rules Each participant can be part of only one team . Teams must work only on the problem statement assigned during the hackathon. Previously completed projects cannot be submitted as the primary solution. Plagiarism or copying another team's work will lead to disqualification . Teams must be able to explain their code and implementation to the judges. Any form of cheating, manipulation, or unfair practice will result in disqualification . Teams must complete and submit their solution within the specified deadline. The judges' decision will be final and binding . Participants must follow the instructions of the organizers throughout the event.
organiser: SNS College of Technology (SNSCT), Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu

raw.details:
HackNext'26 Series 2.0 is a 24-hour hackathon organized by SNS College of Technology at the AI Campus on 8–9 October 2026.

  • Team Size: 1–4 Members
  • Registration Fee : ₹500 per head
  • Problem Statement is provided on the spot
  • Case Price : Upto ₹20000
  • Focus: Innovative Idea • Understandable Coding • Better Presentation
  • Venue: AI Campus, SNS College of Technology
  • Last Date to Register: 6 October 2026
  • Hackathon Date: 8–9 October 2026
  • Hackathon Duration: 24 Hours
  • Reporting Time: 8:30 a.m. (08/10/2026)

    Website: https://hacknext26.vercel.app/

    Registration Link Google Form: Click here to Register for HackNext 2.0

Guidelines

  • Participants can register individually or form a team of 1–4 members.
  • The problem statement will be announced on the spot.
  • Participants may use any suitable programming language, framework, or technology.
  • Teams must build their solution within the 24-hour hackathon period.
  • Participants must bring their own laptop and required accessories.
  • Teams should be prepared for a final project demo and presentation.
  • Participants are responsible for their personal belongings and electronic devices. Organizers will not be responsible for any loss or damage.

Rules

  • Each participant can be part of only one team.
  • Teams must work only on the problem statement assigned during the hackathon.
  • Previously completed projects cannot be submitted as the primary solution.
  • Plagiarism or copying another team's work will lead to disqualification.
  • Teams must be able to explain their code and implementation to the judges.
  • Any form of cheating, manipulation, or unfair practice will result in disqualification.
  • Teams must complete and submit their solution within the specified deadline.
  • The judges' decision will be final and binding.
  • Participants must follow the instructions of the organizers throughout the event.
